label: The Moore machine
subgoals: Apply the next-state function once per input symbol
Read the output from each state visited

label: The Mealy machine
subgoals: Attach each output to a state and input pair
Emit the output on the transition taken

label: Pattern detectors with overlap
subgoals: Slide a window of the pattern length along the input stream
Count every window equal to the pattern, including overlaps
Track the longest matched prefix as the machine's state
